# dam-render test fixtures

Small models used by `tests/render.rs` to verify import + textured PBR rendering across formats.

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `cube.gltf` | Minimal glTF (embedded buffer, no material) — untextured geometry render |
| `textured_cube.gltf` | glTF with an **embedded** base-colour PNG + UVs — embedded-texture path |
| `obj_cube.obj` / `obj_cube.mtl` / `quad.png` | OBJ whose MTL `map_Kd` references a **sibling** PNG — external-texture resolution |
| `textured_cube.fbx` | FBX with an **embedded** base-colour texture — Assimp FBX importer + embedded-texture extraction |
| `quad.png` | The base-colour texture: red/green/blue/yellow quadrants + white grid, so UV mapping and colour are visually obvious and assertable |

## Regenerating the FBX

`textured_cube.fbx` is authored in Blender (embedded texture) — it can't be hand-written. Regenerate with:

```bash
REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) \
  blender --background --python crates/3dam-render/tests/fixtures/make_textured_fbx.py
```

The glTF/OBJ fixtures are generated by short Python snippets (see git history of this directory); they have no external tool dependency.
